messages:
morgan: paging — saw a sharp latency spike for text-generation on hosted us-west-2 at ~14:00 UTC. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> 2.1s, errors 500 spiked to 1.8% :rotating_light:
incident-bot: @channel Incident created: INC-20250302-01. Pager sent to oncall morgan. Auto runbooks attached: "latency-root-check" and "route-fallback".
jamie: on it, pulling live traces and redis/kvcaches. any customer impact flagged?
morgan: some customers saw slow responses and a few timeouts, support queue 7 tickets mentioning slowness. tagging leo for customer comms.
sasha: quick checklist for triage: 1) confirm SLO breach 2) check model worker saturations 3) check network errs 4) evaluate autoscale/eviction logs 5) start mitigations (route to backup region / lower batch size)
jamie: running `kubectl top pods -n runtime --selector=service=model-server` now. noticing CPU saturation on model-workers-3 and elevated GPU mem pressure on worker-7.
morgan: created temporary routing rule to divert 20% traffic to us-east-1 model variant. will monitor.
jamie: added `--max-batch-size=8` on the hot pool to reduce per-request latency, rolling 3 instances.
leo: starting draft for support macro + intercom reply. want to keep it brief and transparent, ask for affected endpoints and ETA.
tilly (support): can I get the customer-facing template too? I'll paste into Zendesk once approved.
sasha: paste here a canonical template we can reuse (internal -> customer -> status page). Keep 3 tiers: urgent status page blurb, short ticket reply, and full follow-up template.
leo: ok dumping a compact macro. tweak as needed.
---
Support macro (short reply for Zendesk / Intercom):
```
Hi {{customer_name}},
Thanks for flagging this — we're seeing elevated latency for some hosted inferencing requests in us-west-2. Our on-call team is actively mitigating and we've routed a portion of traffic to an alternate region.
Impact: occasional slow responses and intermittent timeouts for text-generation endpoints in us-west-2.
Next update: ~15 minutes. If you need immediate mitigation (route all traffic to another region), reply and we'll escalate.
Sincere apologies for the disruption,
— Redwood Inference Support / On-call
```
---
leo: status page blurb we can drop into status.redwood.ai:
```
Summary: We are investigating increased request latency and intermittent errors affecting hosted inference in our us-west-2 region.
Impact: Some customers may experience slower-than-normal responses and occasional timeouts for text-generation.
Mitigation: We have routed a fraction of traffic to an alternate region and are scaling model workers.
Current status: Mitigating — full service still available with degraded latency; updates every 15 minutes.
```
---
jamie: internal incident update template for ops channel (short):
```
INC-20250302-01 | Latency spike | us-west-2
Timeline: 14:00 UTC detection -> 14:03 paging -> 14:08 partial routing -> 14:12 batch-size change
Actions taken: diverted 20% traffic to us-east-1; reduced max-batch-size on hot pool; scaling additional model-workers; investigating GPU memory churn.
Next steps: if error rate >1% for next 10m, increase diversion to 50% and temp pin to quantized variant.
Owner: morgan (oncall) | Escalation: sasha (incidents lead)
```
---
sasha: also adding a quick troubleshooting checklist for support agents to run before escalating to oncall: keep it concise.
---
Agent troubleshooting checklist (for support reps):
```
1) Confirm customer region and endpoint (us-west-2?).
2) Ask for exact request example + recent request_id(s).
3) Check public status page link first (status.redwood.ai) for active incidents.
4) If status shows incident, send support macro above and tag #incidents with ticket id.
5) If no active incident: gather logs (request_id) and run `curl -v` against endpoint to reproduce, note latency and response codes.
6) If you see 500s or timeouts >5s, escalate to oncall with logs and sample request.
7) For urgent enterprise customers, offer immediate routing (we can coordinate with oncall).
```
---
morgan: small update — after diversion p95 improved to 320ms in us-west-2 within 6 minutes, error rate down to 0.4%. continuing to monitor.
tilly (support): sending macro to the 7 queued tickets now. will paste status page link and ask if they want full regional reroute.
leo: can we add a `#incident-ref` tag to the macro with the INC number? helps CS reporting.
sasha: yes add `INC-20250302-01` to the macro footer.
incident-bot: INC-20250302-01 updated status: MITIGATING -> PARTIAL-MITIGATION at 14:14 UTC.
jamie: follow-up ops note — memory churn traced to a failing allocator on worker-7, currently isolating and draining that host.
morgan: handing off to sasha for long tail follow-ups after the page window. sasha, I'll DM logs and the checklist.
sasha: taking over. sasha: will run postmortem template after resolution and add CS follow-up to ensure any customers with data sensitivity get full writeup.
leo: final note for macros — include explicit instructions for customers to provide `request_id` and timestamp to speed triage. I'll update templates now.
tilly (support): thanks — macro live, tickets updated. posting summary to #customer-success in 10.
jamie: keeping the thread open; will post final resolution once worker drain completes and error rate stable for 30 minutes.
